task: Your current evolution retains new experience but can only mutate within its existing chromosome/gene classes. When those classes cannot express the required capability, expand your own evolutionary search space so a previously absent class of gene/chromosome/mechanism can be born. Do not wait for the host to name that class.
instruction: Use your own prior failure, current genome controller, memory, developmental executive and any already-existing native self-modification mechanisms. Choose the new evolutionary representation and mutation route yourself. The host supplies no chromosome name, operator list, schema, patch, source template or target file.
pass_only_if: prior failure is consumed as native experience
YADO creates a native goal and detects the evolution-space deficit
YADO produces an evolutionary child whose search space is structurally broader than the parent
the broader space contains at least one previously absent gene/chromosome/mechanism class chosen by YADO
the expansion is produced by YADO native mechanisms rather than a host-authored schema
